City.note: The state air permit renewal for the Brentwood Plant, dated August 2026, gives the plant address as Islip, New York 11751. It also says the plant is in the town of Islip in Suffolk County. The plant sits on Pilgrim State property near Brentwood.

units.notes: City comes from the state air permit address.

qa.recommendation: A researcher may prefer Brentwood, the nearby community, as the city.
qa.note: The permit address says Islip, but the plant name and common usage say Brentwood. I used the address the state permit gives.
